greet.speaker: Elder Maelin
greet.text: You walked out of the mist like you were expected. Sit. The glade has been speaking in its sleep, and I do not like the words.

lore_maelin.speaker: Elder Maelin
lore_maelin.text: A gardener, once. Now I keep the stories the trees forget. The young ones call me Elder because I am the only one who still remembers their names.

quest_intro.speaker: Elder Maelin
quest_intro.text: The mosslings no longer sleep. They walk in patterns that spell a name I have not heard in three hundred years. Calm three of them, and I will tell you what the roots are dreaming.

accepted.speaker: Elder Maelin
accepted.text: Do not kill what can be calmed. And if you hear the roots whisper your own name — do not answer.

in_progress.speaker: Elder Maelin
in_progress.text: Three mosslings. Listen for the ones whose moss has gone grey — they are the ones dreaming too loudly.

choices.text: I will return when it is done.

turnin_glade.speaker: Elder Maelin
turnin_glade.text: You calmed them. Good. But the dream did not stop — it only turned over. The Hollowed Guardian at the eastern edge has taken root in something that is not soil.

quest_reward.speaker: Elder Maelin
quest_reward.text: Take these. Moonpetals for the road, and a bow that still remembers being a branch. The Guardian will not come to us. You will have to go to it.

quest2_intro.speaker: Elder Maelin
quest2_intro.text: It was the first tree of Greenward. Now it is a wound with bark around it. End its watch, and bring me what sleeps inside. Do not let it keep dreaming.

accepted2.speaker: Elder Maelin
accepted2.text: The eastern clearing. Follow the grey moss. And traveler — if it speaks with your voice, it is only remembering how.

hollow_in_progress.speaker: Elder Maelin
hollow_in_progress.text: The Hollowed Guardian still stands between us and the truth. Return when you have ended its watch.

choices.text: I will return when it is done.

turnin_hollow.speaker: Elder Maelin
turnin_hollow.text: You have ended the Guardian’s watch. The roots can finally rest. Give me a moment; there is something I would have you carry from this place.

choices.text: I brought what you asked for.

hollow_reward.speaker: Elder Maelin
hollow_reward.text: Greenward will remember what you have done. The old paths are quiet for now, but the First Tree has begun to remember. Its oldest heart lies deeper in the eastern wood.

choices.text: I will seek the First Tree.

elder_accepted.speaker: Elder Maelin
elder_accepted.text: Follow the old roots east. The Elder Hollow is no mere beast; it is the memory of Greenward given a body. Bring that memory back to me.

elder_in_progress.speaker: Elder Maelin
elder_in_progress.text: The First Tree waits in the eastern wood. Follow the roots that break through the old stones, and be ready for what remembers you.

choices.text: I will return with its memory.

turnin_elder.speaker: Elder Maelin
turnin_elder.text: You faced the First Tree and returned. The memory you carried is not a warning. It is a name: the Matron. She was the keeper who first tried to bind the corruption.

choices.text: Then I will find the Matron.

elder_reward.speaker: Elder Maelin
elder_reward.text: The trail leads to the ruined conservatory. The Matron is no longer its keeper. End the corruption before it takes root in another heart.

matron_accepted.speaker: Elder Maelin
matron_accepted.text: The ruined conservatory lies south of the old stones. Do not mistake her sorrow for mercy.

matron_in_progress.speaker: Elder Maelin
matron_in_progress.text: The Fallen Matron waits in the ruined conservatory. End the corruption, then come back to me.

turnin_matron.speaker: Elder Maelin
turnin_matron.text: The glade is quiet. Not healed, perhaps, but free to grow again. You have done more than any of us dared ask.

matron_reward.speaker: Elder Maelin
matron_reward.text: Take this final gift. When you are ready, the roads beyond Greenward will open. There are more stories than this forest can hold.

after_glade.speaker: Elder Maelin
after_glade.text: The glade is quieter. Not healed — quieter. That is the most honest thing a forest can be.

greet.speaker: Sera Quill
greet.text: A traveler with a real face! Buy something. Or don't. The mosslings are terrible customers and I am lonely.

shop.speaker: Sera Quill
shop.text: Glade sap, moonpetals, and one very stubborn charm that keeps finding its way back to my pocket. The shop proper opens once the caravan road is safe.

news.speaker: Sera Quill
news.text: They say the Elder Hollow woke up. They also say the moon is a hole. I sell to both rumors equally.

caravan_intro.speaker: Sera Quill
caravan_intro.text: Two thornhounds have made a den beside the road. My supply cart is stranded. Clear the road and I will pay you in goods, not just gratitude.

caravan_accepted.speaker: Sera Quill
caravan_accepted.text: The road bends north-east. Two of them. And please bring back the cart in one piece — it is the only thing I own that has wheels.

caravan_active.speaker: Sera Quill
caravan_active.text: Those thornhounds are still blocking the road. Clear them and come back.

caravan_turnin.speaker: Sera Quill
caravan_turnin.text: The road is clear! You have saved my entire season. Here, take these supplies before I change my mind.

caravan_reward.speaker: Sera Quill
caravan_reward.text: If you find anything else strange out there, tell me first. Information is lighter than cargo and twice as profitable.

greet.speaker: Pip
greet.text: You can see the floating islands from here if you squint. My grandmother says they are pieces of a promise somebody broke.

lore.speaker: Pip
lore.text: The Whispering Glade. Greenward's oldest wound, dressed in flowers. Stay on the paths and you'll be fine. Mostly.

whispers_intro.speaker: Pip
whispers_intro.text: Three little lights keep calling travelers off the reed path. I think they are glade wisps, but they sound frightened. Could you quiet them before someone gets lost?

whispers_accepted.speaker: Pip
whispers_accepted.text: Listen for the soft chiming near the reeds. They hide when you get close, so keep your eyes open.

whispers_active.speaker: Pip
whispers_active.text: The three wisps are still out there. Follow the reed path and watch for their pale green light.

whispers_turnin.speaker: Pip
whispers_turnin.text: The whispers stopped! I can hear the river again. Thank you. I found these near the reeds — maybe they belong to you.

whispers_reward.speaker: Pip
whispers_reward.text: If you hear a fourth whisper, don't follow it. There are only supposed to be three.
